== Biography ==
06 Oct 1901, Jane Glasgow, Spinster, 74 years, daughter of a farmer. Informant: David Glasgow, brother, present at death.
<ref>Ireland Civil Registration Deaths Index 1864 - 1958</ref>
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-585]] is assessed at 98% (proved). William’s will names daughter Jane living with him, while Jane’s 1901 death and census identify David as her brother. The Montober-to-Beltonanean family continuity makes the named daughter highly specific.

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Compare the original will’s daughter clause with Jane’s death record.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-691 PRONI Will Calendars: Probate of the Will of William Glasgow late of Montober County Tyrone Farmer who died 9 April 1898 granted at Armagh to Allen Glasgow of Drumnamalta and Robert J. Charles of Beltoninanean both said County Farmers.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
